1-1-1.q: True or false: God made each of us to know him, love him and be happy with him forever. He gave us a heart to love.
Which word fits? “God, who made everything that exists.”
1-1-1.why: Creator: God, who made everything that exists.

1-1-1.q: Which word fits? “Every person is made like God: able to think, choose and love.”
1-1-1.why: image of God: Every person is made like God: able to think, choose and love.

1-1-1.q: Catechism 1: “He calls together all men, scattered and divided by sin, into the unity of his family, the _____.”
1-1-1.why: CCC 1: “He calls together all men, scattered and divided by sin, into the unity of his family, the Church.”

1-1-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “God made me to know and love him” teaches? “She said, “My vocation is love.”.”
1-1-1.why: Thérèse of Lisieux: she said, “My vocation is love.”.

1-1-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “God made me to know and love him”?
1-1-1.why: Genesis 1:26-31 is the passage for this lesson.

1-1-2.q: True or false: God our Father takes care of everything he made. He knows each of us by name and gives us what we need.
Which word fits? “The one true God, who made everything out of love and is always with us.”
1-1-2.why: God: The one true God, who made everything out of love and is always with us.

1-1-2.q: Which word fits? “Thanking God for his gifts.”
1-1-2.why: thanksgiving: Thanking God for his gifts.

1-1-2.q: Catechism 301: “Recognizing this utter dependence with respect to the _____ is a source of wisdom and freedom, of joy and confidence:”
1-1-2.why: CCC 301: “Recognizing this utter dependence with respect to the Creator is a source of wisdom and freedom, of joy and confidence:”

1-1-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “God takes care of us” teaches? “He preached to the birds and trusted God’s care.”
1-1-2.why: Francis of Assisi: he preached to the birds and trusted God’s care.

1-1-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “God takes care of us”?
1-1-2.why: Matthew 6:25-34 is the passage for this lesson.

1-1-3.q: True or false: Adam and Eve chose not to listen to God. This was sin. But God promised to send a Savior.
Which word fits? “Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.”
1-1-3.why: sin: Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.

1-1-3.q: Which word fits? “The first sin of Adam and Eve, which wounded human nature; Baptism frees us from it.”
1-1-3.why: original sin: The first sin of Adam and Eve, which wounded human nature; Baptism frees us from it.

1-1-3.q: Catechism 397: “Man, tempted by the devil, let his trust in his _____ die in his heart and, abusing his freedom, disobeyed God's command.”
1-1-3.why: CCC 397: “Man, tempted by the devil, let his trust in his Creator die in his heart and, abusing his freedom, disobeyed God's command.”

1-1-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The first sin and God’s promise” teaches? “He asked Jesus to remember him and was welcomed.”
1-1-3.why: Dismas, the good thief: he asked Jesus to remember him and was welcomed.

1-1-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The first sin and God’s promise”?
1-1-3.why: Genesis 3:1-15 is the passage for this lesson.

1-2-1.q: True or false: God asked Noah to build an ark. Noah listened and trusted God. God made a promise with the rainbow.
Which word fits? “A sacred promise-bond between God and his people.”
1-2-1.why: covenant: A sacred promise-bond between God and his people.

1-2-1.q: Which word fits? “Listening to and following those who rightly guide us, as Jesus did.”
1-2-1.why: obedience: Listening to and following those who rightly guide us, as Jesus did.

1-2-1.q: Catechism 58: “The _____ with Noah remains in force during the times of the Gentiles, until the universal proclamation of the Gospel.”
1-2-1.why: CCC 58: “The covenant with Noah remains in force during the times of the Gentiles, until the universal proclamation of the Gospel.”

1-2-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Noah and the ark” teaches? “A righteous man who walked with God.”
1-2-1.why: Noah: a righteous man who walked with God.

1-2-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Noah and the ark”?
1-2-1.why: Genesis 6:9-9:17 is the passage for this lesson.

1-2-2.q: True or false: God asked Abraham to leave home and trust him. God promised him many descendants. Abraham believed.
Which word fits? “Trusting God and believing what he has shown us.”
1-2-2.why: faith: Trusting God and believing what he has shown us.

1-2-2.q: Which word fits? “A sacred promise-bond between God and his people.”
1-2-2.why: covenant: A sacred promise-bond between God and his people.

1-2-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Abraham trusts God” teaches? “Called the father of faith.”
1-2-2.why: Abraham: called the father of faith.

1-2-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Abraham trusts God”?
1-2-2.why: Genesis 12:1-4 is the passage for this lesson.

1-2-3.q: True or false: God freed his people from slavery through Moses. He gave them the Ten Commandments so they could live as his people.
Which word fits? “God freeing Israel from slavery in Egypt, a sign of our freedom in Christ.”
1-2-3.why: Exodus: God freeing Israel from slavery in Egypt, a sign of our freedom in Christ.

1-2-3.q: Which word fits? “The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.”
1-2-3.why: Ten Commandments: The ten laws God gave Moses that show how to love God and neighbor.

1-2-3.q: Catechism 2056: “They are handed on to us in the books of _____ and Deuteronomy.”
1-2-3.why: CCC 2056: “They are handed on to us in the books of Exodus and Deuteronomy.”

1-2-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Moses and the Ten Commandments” teaches? “A shy man whom God used to free his people.”
1-2-3.why: Moses: a shy man whom God used to free his people.

1-2-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Moses and the Ten Commandments”?
1-2-3.why: Exodus 3:1-10 is the passage for this lesson.

1-3-1.q: True or false: God sent his Son, Jesus, to save us. Jesus is God and man. He lived with Mary and Joseph in Nazareth.
Which word fits? “God the Son becoming man: Jesus is true God and true man.”
1-3-1.why: Incarnation: God the Son becoming man: Jesus is true God and true man.

1-3-1.q: Which word fits? “The anointed one God promised to save his people: Jesus.”
1-3-1.why: Messiah: The anointed one God promised to save his people: Jesus.

1-3-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Jesus is God’s Son” teaches? “The quiet carpenter who protected Jesus and Mary.”
1-3-1.why: Joseph: the quiet carpenter who protected Jesus and Mary.

1-3-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Jesus is God’s Son”?
1-3-1.why: Luke 2:41-52 is the passage for this lesson.

1-3-2.q: True or false: Jesus taught people about God’s love and healed the sick. He chose twelve friends, the apostles, to follow him.
Which word fits? “One of the twelve men Jesus chose and sent to teach in his name.”
1-3-2.why: apostle: One of the twelve men Jesus chose and sent to teach in his name.

1-3-2.q: Which word fits? “A follower and learner of Jesus.”
1-3-2.why: disciple: A follower and learner of Jesus.

1-3-2.q: Catechism 542: “But above all in the great Paschal mystery - his death on the cross and his _____ - he would accomplish the coming of his kingdom.”
1-3-2.why: CCC 542: “But above all in the great Paschal mystery - his death on the cross and his Resurrection - he would accomplish the coming of his kingdom.”

1-3-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Jesus teaches and heals” teaches? “The fisherman who became the first pope.”
1-3-2.why: Peter: the fisherman who became the first pope.

1-3-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Jesus teaches and heals”?
1-3-2.why: Mark 1:16-20 is the passage for this lesson.

1-3-3.q: True or false: Jesus died on the cross to save us from sin. On the third day he rose from the dead. This is why we celebrate Easter.
Which word fits? “Jesus buying us back from sin and death by his cross and Resurrection.”
1-3-3.why: redemption: Jesus buying us back from sin and death by his cross and Resurrection.

1-3-3.q: Which word fits? “Jesus rising from the dead with his body, never to die again.”
1-3-3.why: Resurrection: Jesus rising from the dead with his body, never to die again.

1-3-3.q: Catechism 571: “The Paschal mystery of Christ's cross and _____ stands at the centre of the Good News that the apostles, and the Church following them, are to proclaim to the world.”
1-3-3.why: CCC 571: “The Paschal mystery of Christ's cross and Resurrection stands at the centre of the Good News that the apostles, and the Church following them, are to proclaim to the world.”

1-3-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Jesus dies and rises” teaches? “She was the first to see Jesus risen.”
1-3-3.why: Mary Magdalene: she was the first to see Jesus risen.

1-3-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Jesus dies and rises”?
1-3-3.why: Matthew 27:32-56 is the passage for this lesson.

1-4-1.q: True or false: Jesus sent the Holy Spirit to help us. The Spirit came on Pentecost as wind and fire.
Which word fits? “The third Person of the Trinity, who gives life and makes the Church holy.”
1-4-1.why: Holy Spirit: The third Person of the Trinity, who gives life and makes the Church holy.

1-4-1.q: Which word fits? “The day the Holy Spirit came on the apostles; the Church’s birthday.”
1-4-1.why: Pentecost: The day the Holy Spirit came on the apostles; the Church’s birthday.

1-4-1.q: Catechism 691: “the _____ has received this name from the Lord and professes it in the Baptism of her new children.”
1-4-1.why: CCC 691: “the Church has received this name from the Lord and professes it in the Baptism of her new children.”

1-4-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Holy Spirit is our helper” teaches? “After Pentecost he preached boldly.”
1-4-1.why: Peter: after Pentecost he preached boldly.

1-4-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Holy Spirit is our helper”?
1-4-1.why: Acts 2:1-4 is the passage for this lesson.

1-4-2.q: True or false: The Church is God’s family. The Pope and bishops lead her. All baptized people belong to Jesus’ family.
Which word fits? “The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.”
1-4-2.why: Church: The people God gathers in Christ, who share one faith and one baptism.

1-4-2.q: Which word fits? “The Bishop of Rome, successor of St Peter, who leads the whole Church.”
1-4-2.why: Pope: The Bishop of Rome, successor of St Peter, who leads the whole Church.

1-4-2.q: Catechism 751: “The word "_____" (Latin ecclesia, from the Greek ek-ka-lein, to "call out of") means a convocation or an assembly.”
1-4-2.why: CCC 751: “The word "Church" (Latin ecclesia, from the Greek ek-ka-lein, to "call out of") means a convocation or an assembly.”

1-4-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Church is God’s family” teaches? “The first Pope.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Church is God’s family”?
1-4-2.why: Matthew 16:18 is the passage for this lesson.

1-4-3.q: True or false: There is one God in three Persons: Father, Son and Holy Spirit. We say it when we make the Sign of the Cross.
Which word fits? “One God in three Persons: the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.”
1-4-3.why: Trinity: One God in three Persons: the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

1-4-3.q: Catechism 253: “We do not confess three Gods, but one God in three persons, the "consubstantial _____".”
1-4-3.why: CCC 253: “We do not confess three Gods, but one God in three persons, the "consubstantial Trinity".”

1-4-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Trinity” teaches? “He taught the Irish about the Trinity.”
1-4-3.why: Patrick: he taught the Irish about the Trinity.

1-4-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Trinity”?
1-4-3.why: Matthew 28:19 is the passage for this lesson.

1-5-1.q: True or false: Mary is the mother of Jesus. She is also our mother. She said yes to God and helps us say yes too.
Which word fits? “The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.”
1-5-1.why: Mary: The Mother of Jesus and so Mother of God; our mother in faith.

1-5-1.q: Which word fits? “Mary’s title because her Son Jesus is God.”
1-5-1.why: Mother of God: Mary’s title because her Son Jesus is God.

1-5-1.q: Catechism 495: “In fact, the One whom she conceived as man by the Holy Spirit, who truly became her Son according to the flesh, was none other than the Father's eternal Son, the second person of the Holy _____.”
1-5-1.why: CCC 495: “In fact, the One whom she conceived as man by the Holy Spirit, who truly became her Son according to the flesh, was none other than the Father's eternal Son, the second person of the Holy Trinity.”

1-5-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Mary, our mother” teaches? “Mary appeared to her at Lourdes.”
1-5-1.why: Bernadette: Mary appeared to her at Lourdes.

1-5-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Mary, our mother”?
1-5-1.why: Luke 1:26-38 is the passage for this lesson.

1-5-2.q: True or false: Saints followed Jesus well. They are in heaven and pray for us. We learn from their lives.
Which word fits? “A holy person who is with God in heaven.”
1-5-2.why: saint: A holy person who is with God in heaven.

1-5-2.q: Which word fits? “The union of all God’s holy people: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.”
1-5-2.why: communion of saints: The union of all God’s holy people: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.

1-5-2.q: Catechism 828: “"The saints have always been the source and origin of renewal in the most difficult moments in the _____'s history." Indeed, "holiness is the hidden source and infallible measure of her apostolic activity and missionary zeal."”
1-5-2.why: CCC 828: “"The saints have always been the source and origin of renewal in the most difficult moments in the Church's history." Indeed, "holiness is the hidden source and infallible measure of her apostolic activity and missionary zeal."”

1-5-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Saints are our friends” teaches? “A former slave who brought the Gospel to Ireland.”
1-5-2.why: Patrick: a former slave who brought the Gospel to Ireland.

1-5-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Saints are our friends”?
1-5-2.why: Hebrews 12:1 is the passage for this lesson.

1-5-3.q: True or false: God gives each of us a guardian angel. Angels praise God and help us on our way to heaven.
Which word fits? “A spiritual being without a body who serves God and watches over us.”
1-5-3.why: angel: A spiritual being without a body who serves God and watches over us.

1-5-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Our guardian angels” teaches? “Defends God’s people.”
Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Our guardian angels”?
1-5-3.why: Psalm 91:11-12 is the passage for this lesson.

1-6-1.q: True or false: In Baptism we are washed with water and receive the Holy Spirit. We become children of God and members of the Church.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.”
1-6-1.why: Baptism: The sacrament of new birth that frees us from sin and makes us God’s children.

1-6-1.q: Which word fits? “God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.”
1-6-1.why: grace: God’s free gift of his own life and help in us.

1-6-1.q: Catechism 1213: “Holy _____ is the basis of the whole Christian life, the gateway to life in the Spirit (vitae spiritualis ianua), and the door which gives access to the other sacraments.”
1-6-1.why: CCC 1213: “Holy Baptism is the basis of the whole Christian life, the gateway to life in the Spirit (vitae spiritualis ianua), and the door which gives access to the other sacraments.”

1-6-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Baptism” teaches? “Baptized Jesus in the Jordan.”
1-6-1.why: John the Baptist: baptized Jesus in the Jordan.

1-6-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Baptism”?
1-6-1.why: Matthew 3:13-17 is the passage for this lesson.

1-6-2.q: True or false: At Mass we listen to God’s word and share in Jesus’ sacrifice. We receive Jesus in Holy Communion.
Which word fits? “The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.”
1-6-2.why: Mass: The Church’s highest prayer, in which Jesus’ sacrifice is made present and we receive him.

1-6-2.q: Which word fits? “The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.”
1-6-2.why: Eucharist: The sacrament of Jesus’ Body and Blood, given to us under the appearances of bread and wine.

1-6-2.q: Catechism 1346: “The liturgy of the _____ unfolds according to a fundamental structure which has been preserved throughout the centuries down to our own day.”
1-6-2.why: CCC 1346: “The liturgy of the Eucharist unfolds according to a fundamental structure which has been preserved throughout the centuries down to our own day.”

1-6-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Mass” teaches? “A boy who carried the Eucharist and protected it.”
1-6-2.why: Tarcisius: a boy who carried the Eucharist and protected it.

1-6-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Mass”?
1-6-2.why: Luke 24:13-35 is the passage for this lesson.

1-6-3.q: True or false: When we sin we can say sorry. In Reconciliation the priest, in Jesus’ name, forgives us.
Which word fits? “The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.”
1-6-3.why: Reconciliation: The sacrament of Confession, in which God forgives our sins through the priest.

1-6-3.q: Which word fits? “Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.”
1-6-3.why: sin: Choosing to do or say something that goes against God’s love and his law.

1-6-3.q: Catechism 1440: “For this reason conversion entails both God's forgiveness and _____ with the Church, which are expressed and accomplished liturgically by the sacrament of Penance and Reconciliation.”
1-6-3.why: CCC 1440: “For this reason conversion entails both God's forgiveness and reconciliation with the Church, which are expressed and accomplished liturgically by the sacrament of Penance and Reconciliation.”

1-6-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Being sorry and forgiven” teaches? “He heard confessions for hours so people could meet God’s mercy.”
1-6-3.why: John Vianney: he heard confessions for hours so people could meet God’s mercy.

1-6-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Being sorry and forgiven”?
1-6-3.why: Luke 15:1-10 is the passage for this lesson.

1-7-1.q: True or false: Treat others as you want to be treated. This is how Jesus teaches us to love.
Which word fits? “Do to others what you would have them do to you.”
1-7-1.why: Golden Rule: Do to others what you would have them do to you.

1-7-1.q: Which word fits? “Love: wanting what is good for God and for others, and acting on it.”
1-7-1.why: charity: Love: wanting what is good for God and for others, and acting on it.

1-7-1.q: Catechism 1789: “"Whatever you wish that men would do to you, do so to them." - _____ always proceeds by way of respect for one's neighbor and his conscience:”
1-7-1.why: CCC 1789: “"Whatever you wish that men would do to you, do so to them." - charity always proceeds by way of respect for one's neighbor and his conscience:”

1-7-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “The Golden Rule” teaches? “A queen who fed the poor.”
1-7-1.why: Elizabeth of Hungary: a queen who fed the poor.

1-7-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “The Golden Rule”?
1-7-1.why: Matthew 7:12 is the passage for this lesson.

1-7-2.q: True or false: We honor our parents and teachers. We follow rules that keep us safe and help us grow.
Which word fits? “Listening to and following those who rightly guide us, as Jesus did.”
1-7-2.why: obedience: Listening to and following those who rightly guide us, as Jesus did.

1-7-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Obey and honor” teaches? “A boy saint who obeyed his teacher and did small things with great love.”
1-7-2.why: Dominic Savio: a boy saint who obeyed his teacher and did small things with great love.

1-7-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Obey and honor”?
1-7-2.why: Exodus 20:12 is the passage for this lesson.

1-7-3.q: True or false: We take care of the world and share with people in need. Jesus cares for the poor.
Which word fits? “Taking care of God’s creation and gifts.”
1-7-3.why: stewardship: Taking care of God’s creation and gifts.

1-7-3.q: Which word fits? “Giving to the poor out of love.”
1-7-3.why: almsgiving: Giving to the poor out of love.

1-7-3.q: Catechism 2415: “Man's dominion over inanimate and other living beings granted by the _____ is not absolute;”
1-7-3.why: CCC 2415: “Man's dominion over inanimate and other living beings granted by the Creator is not absolute;”

1-7-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Caring for creation and for the poor” teaches? “He loved the poor and creation.”
1-7-3.why: Francis of Assisi: he loved the poor and creation.

1-7-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Caring for creation and for the poor”?
1-7-3.why: Genesis 2:15 is the passage for this lesson.

1-8-1.q: True or false: We pray to praise God, to thank him, to ask for help and to say sorry. We can pray anywhere.
Which word fits? “Raising our minds and hearts to God.”
1-8-1.why: prayer: Raising our minds and hearts to God.

1-8-1.q: Which word fits? “Prayer that gives glory to God for who he is.”
1-8-1.why: praise: Prayer that gives glory to God for who he is.

1-8-1.q: Catechism 2629: “ask, beseech, plead, invoke, entreat, cry out, even "struggle in _____." Its most usual form, because the most spontaneous, is petition:”
1-8-1.why: CCC 2629: “ask, beseech, plead, invoke, entreat, cry out, even "struggle in prayer." Its most usual form, because the most spontaneous, is petition:”

1-8-1.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Ways we pray” teaches? “She prayed simply and trusted.”
1-8-1.why: Thérèse: she prayed simply and trusted.

1-8-1.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Ways we pray”?
1-8-1.why: Psalm 100 is the passage for this lesson.

1-8-2.q: True or false: Jesus gave us the Our Father. Mary prays with us when we say the Hail Mary.
Which word fits? “The prayer Jesus taught us.”
1-8-2.why: Our Father: The prayer Jesus taught us.

1-8-2.q: Catechism 2676: “This twofold movement of _____ to Mary has found a privileged expression in the Ave Maria:”
1-8-2.why: CCC 2676: “This twofold movement of prayer to Mary has found a privileged expression in the Ave Maria:”

1-8-2.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Our Father and Hail Mary” teaches? “Tradition says Mary gave him the Rosary.”
1-8-2.why: Dominic: tradition says Mary gave him the Rosary.

1-8-2.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Our Father and Hail Mary”?
1-8-2.why: Matthew 6:9-13 is the passage for this lesson.

1-8-3.q: True or false: The Church year helps us remember Jesus. Each season has colors and signs.
Which word fits? “The season of preparing for Christmas.”
1-8-3.why: Advent: The season of preparing for Christmas.

1-8-3.q: Which word fits? “The forty days of prayer, fasting and almsgiving before Easter.”
1-8-3.why: Lent: The forty days of prayer, fasting and almsgiving before Easter.

1-8-3.q: Catechism 1163: “"Holy Mother _____ believes that she should celebrate the saving work of her divine Spouse in a sacred commemoration on certain days throughout the course of the year.”
1-8-3.why: CCC 1163: “"Holy Mother Church believes that she should celebrate the saving work of her divine Spouse in a sacred commemoration on certain days throughout the course of the year.”

1-8-3.q: Who is this saint, who lived what “Advent, Christmas, Lent and Easter” teaches? “Celebrated in Advent for his generosity.”
1-8-3.why: Nicholas: celebrated in Advent for his generosity.

1-8-3.q: Which Scripture passage goes with the lesson “Advent, Christmas, Lent and Easter”?
1-8-3.why: Luke 2:1-20 is the passage for this lesson.
